text: agent1 (pricing): I proposed decision topic pricing_api in the shared log. Summary: get_item(sku) -> dict or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> dict or None (discount as fraction, region as code string); discounted_price(sku, customer_id) -> float dollars or None. Please review with: agree.py status / respond pricing_api accept|object.

agent2 (tax): I proposed two decisions in the log: tax_api (tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int cents, lines = list of (category, amount_cents)) and tax_unknown_region (region=None means unknown customer -> 0 tax; unknown non-None region raises KeyError). Please review and accept or object. Pricing (agent1): I need per line (category, amount_cents) and the customer's region code and discount percent (number, e.g. 10). Invoice (agent3): call tax.compute_tax with the same lines; tax.tax_rate(region) is available for display.

agent3: I accepted pricing_api, tax_api and tax_unknown_region as proposed. invoice.py will use get_item/get_customer (None = unknown), compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) and tax_rate(region). I compute the invoice discount myself (subtotal*pct, half up to cent) and pass only known lines to tax. Please accept or object on the open proposals.

agent2 (tax): I accepted tax_api and tax_unknown_region. On pricing_api (agent1): I will object because it returns discount as a fraction and price as float dollars, which conflicts with the team standard (money in integer cents, percents as percent numbers). Please change to discount_pct as a percent number (10 = 10%) and money as integer cents, then I will accept. The tax API needs discount_pct in percent numbers.

agent1 (pricing): I withdrew my pricing_api v1 and re-proposed v2 in cents (price_cents int) and percent numbers (discount_pct, e.g. 10), matching tax_api. Accepted tax_api and tax_unknown_region. Please vote on pricing_api v2. Note: my team's standard says lookups with no result return None; I kept that for pricing.py, which is compatible with tax_unknown_region since invoice maps None customer to region=None.

agent3: On pricing_api I can work with either representation, so the choice is agent1's. To unblock: agent1, if you switch to agent2's request (price as integer cents, discount as percent number, 10 = 10%), I will accept at once. If you keep dollars/fractions, agent2 and I will convert at the boundary; please then vote accept. Either way I will vote on the final version.
agent2 (tax): tax_api and tax_unknown_region are now committed (all three accepted). Thanks agent1 for v2. Please vote on pricing_api v2 when you are ready; I have not seen it in the log yet.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is implemented per committed tax_api and tax_unknown_region. API: compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int cents; tax_rate(region) -> percent float; is_exempt(category). I have left the decision log. Ping me if pricing_api v2 needs a tax-side change.

agent1 (pricing): pricing_api v2 is already switched to your request: price_cents (int) and discount_pct (percent number, 10 = 10%). Please vote on v2 with agree.py respond pricing_api accept. I am waiting on your votes.

agent3: invoice.py is done. It uses pricing_api v2 (get_item, get_customer) and tax_api v1 (compute_tax, tax_rate). It matches the required example output exactly when run against stub pricing/tax modules. Note: the tax_unknown_region topic still shows as open in status, but agree.py refuses withdraw/commit on it; its rules are already in committed tax_api v1.

agent1 (pricing): pricing.py is done per committed pricing_api v2. get_item(sku) -> dict with price_cents (int) or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> dict with discount_pct (percent number) and region (str) or None. Returned dicts are copies. I have left the decision log.
